name: Easy Eggplant Lasagna-ish
subtitle: Made up by Marta
notes: It’s a very basic, tasty way to enjoy some purple veg!

steps.title: Cook the beef
steps.body: Cook **1 medium onion** and **1 lb ground beef** together on the stove, seasoning with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Slice the eggplant
steps.body: Slice **2 medium eggplants** into thin rounds and cover the bottom of a 9×13 pan (should use about half of the eggplant).

steps.title: Add the garlic butter
steps.body: Melt **2 Tbsp butter** and add **2 cloves garlic, minced**, then brush the mixture over the bottom layer of eggplant. Cover with the meat and onion mixture.

steps.title: Add the top layer
steps.body: Add another layer of eggplant over the top of the meat and onion.

steps.title: Add the sauce and cheese
steps.body: Pour **1 can pasta sauce** over the entire thing, spreading and allowing it to seep down between the eggplant rounds. Cover with **about a cup mozzarella cheese**, shredded or sliced, and sprinkle garlic salt on top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Pop it in the oven for 45 minutes, or until the eggplant in the middle of the pan is soft.
